environment: Actual .NET browser WASM, native WASI and Worker public API under Node

tests.name: Demo C# builds a dynamic CLR type and invokes generated JavaScript
Real C# System.IO inputs, binary outputs and snapshots cross the Worker API
Automatic WASM fallback retains files for a real framework-dependent program
Persistent workspaces preserve managed file state across generic invocations and API edits
Managed file changes survive a structured C# exception
Real native WASI command registers and executes through compiler Worker RPC
Native execution pre-abort leaves a usable compiler and starts no native program
A real infinite native WASI loop is terminated by its Worker deadline
